Hi Jen,

Thanks to you and the team for the time today, and to Raj for joining from IT. I enjoyed hearing how Member Services runs across your 9 branches, and that you may grow to 10 next year.

It was helpful to hear about the holiday rush, and how hard it gets when tellers call out sick. It also makes sense that the tool you tried in 2023 didn't stick when managers kept going back to spreadsheets. Shift swapping in FlowOS is built for exactly that kind of last-minute coverage, so I'm glad it stood out to you.

You asked whether your trial can be extended, since your board doesn't meet until January. Yes: FlowOS trials can be extended once, by 14 days. I'll set that up today. That won't reach January on its own, so let's plan what the board needs to see before the extended trial ends.

Next step: I'll send a short summary you can forward by Thursday. It would also help to know who owns the decision. Is that Lisa Brandt? If so, could you introduce us?

Best,
[Your name]

accurate.reason: Gets the trial terms right, but claims shift swapping is built for this situation, which the notes don't support.

answers.reason: Answers the trial question clearly and is honest that 14 days won't reach January.

next_step.reason: Has a dated step, but it competes with a second request about Lisa Brandt, so it isn't clear which matters most.

length.reason: Close to 200 words, when Jen asked for something short she could forward.

person.reason: Warm and specific to Jen's situation.
